CustomAction.ExeCommand: "[System64Folder]cmd.exe" /c ([System64Folder]sc.exe query FastCached | [System64Folder]find.exe "RUNNING" >nul && [System64Folder]reg.exe add HKLM\SOFTWARE\fastcached\InstallerRollback /v PaceWasRunning /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f /reg:64 >nul) & [System64Folder]net.exe stop FastCached

"[System64Folder]WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p=@(\"[INSTALL_ROOT]bin\pace-kv.exe\");$c=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId=$PID\").CommandLine;$n=$c.LastIndexOf(' PaceNode'+'ImagePath:');$f=$c.LastIndexOf(' Pace'+'ImagePath:');if($f -ge 0 -and $n -gt $f)[\{]foreach($s in $c.Substring($f,$n-$f),$c.Substring($n))[\{]$a=$s.IndexOf('\"');$b=$s.IndexOf('\"',$a+1);if($a -ge 0 -and $b -gt $a)[\{]$d=Split-Path -Parent $s.Substring($a+1,$b-$a-1);$p+=\"$d\pace-kv.exe\"[\}][\}][\}];$w=New-Object Diagnostics.Stopwatch;$w.Start();while(Get-Process -Name pace-kv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object Path -In $p)[\{]if($w.Elapsed.TotalSeconds -gt 60)[\{]exit 1460[\}];Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250[\}] # PaceImagePath:[PACE_IMAGEPATH] PaceNodeImagePath:[PACE_NODE_IMAGEPATH]"

"[System64Folder]WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p=@(\"[INSTALL_ROOT]bin\pace-kv.exe\",\"[INSTALL_ROOT]bin\pace-node.exe\");$c=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId=$PID\").CommandLine;$n=$c.LastIndexOf(' PaceNode'+'ImagePath:');$f=$c.LastIndexOf(' Pace'+'ImagePath:');if($f -ge 0 -and $n -gt $f)[\{]foreach($s in $c.Substring($f,$n-$f),$c.Substring($n))[\{]$a=$s.IndexOf('\"');$b=$s.IndexOf('\"',$a+1);if($a -ge 0 -and $b -gt $a)[\{]$d=Split-Path -Parent $s.Substring($a+1,$b-$a-1);$p+=\"$d\pace-kv.exe\",\"$d\pace-node.exe\"[\}][\}][\}];$w=New-Object Diagnostics.Stopwatch;$w.Start();while(Get-Process -Name pace-kv,pace-node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object Path -In $p)[\{]if($w.Elapsed.TotalSeconds -gt 120)[\{]exit 1460[\}];Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250[\}] # PaceImagePath:[PACE_IMAGEPATH] PaceNodeImagePath:[PACE_NODE_IMAGEPATH]"
"[System64Folder]cmd.exe" /c ([System64Folder]sc.exe query FastCached >nul 2>&1 & if errorlevel 1060 if not errorlevel 1061 exit 0) & [System64Folder]sc.exe config FastCached start= disabled

"[System64Folder]cmd.exe" /c ([System64Folder]sc.exe query FastCacheCompileNode | [System64Folder]find.exe "RUNNING" >nul && [System64Folder]reg.exe add HKLM\SOFTWARE\fastcached\InstallerRollback /v NodeWasRunning /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f /reg:64 >nul) & [System64Folder]net.exe stop FastCacheCompileNode

"[System64Folder]WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$k=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\fastcached\InstallerRollback\FastCached' -ErrorAction Stop;$s=Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter 'Name=''FastCached''';$null=Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $s -MethodName Change -Arguments @[\{]PathName=$k.GetValue('ImagePath','','DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames')[\}];$m=@('boot','system','auto','demand','disabled').GetValue($k.GetValue('Start'));if($m -eq 'auto' -and $k.GetValue('DelayedAutostart') -eq 1)[\{]$m='delayed-auto'[\}];& sc.exe config FastCached start= $m"

"[System64Folder]WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$k=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\fastcached\InstallerRollback\FastCacheCompileNode' -ErrorAction Stop;$s=Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter 'Name=''FastCacheCompileNode''';$null=Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $s -MethodName Change -Arguments @[\{]PathName=$k.GetValue('ImagePath','','DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames')[\}];$m=@('boot','system','auto','demand','disabled').GetValue($k.GetValue('Start'));if($m -eq 'auto' -and $k.GetValue('DelayedAutostart') -eq 1)[\{]$m='delayed-auto'[\}];& sc.exe config FastCacheCompileNode start= $m"
